written: 2026-10-29, before any classifier was trained or any result computed
purpose: Candidate diagnostic: an unsupervised (k-means) market-regime classifier trained on DEV S1 only, frozen, then applied to S2 without refitting. Compares its regime scorecard with the human-set rules of ADR 0044 (R1 trailing-90d band, R2 drawdown). Elimination diagnostic only; never evidence of passing; DEV was used to pick the candidates, so not an independent test.
data: DEV only: S1 2021-04-01..2023-09-18 (9 symbols) and S2 2024-07-15..2025-10-20 (BTC excluded), reads guarded by strong_search_dev.assert_allowed. Candidate daily series are the saved ones from ADR 0044 (candidate_daily_series.json.gz; measured alt cost PE-ed757f47..., entry-day attribution). No validation / locked / IW1 / paper window, no preregistration activated.
index: equal-weight daily-rebalanced close-to-close index of the segment's symbols (same as ADR 0026/0044). Label of day d uses closes through day d-1 only.

features.f2_vol30: standard deviation of the 30 daily index returns ending at p
features.valid_from: p >= 60 days after the segment's read start; earlier days are label NA
features.standardise: z-score with the mean and std of the S1 training days only; frozen and reused for S2

classifier.algorithm: k-means, Euclidean, k=3 (single configuration, no other k tried), k-means++ seeding, rng numpy default_rng(20261029), 50 restarts, 200 Lloyd iterations max, keep lowest inertia
classifier.training: all valid S1 days ONLY. After training the centroids, scaler and label order are written to the evidence folder and frozen; S2 is labelled by nearest frozen centroid, no refit, no re-tuning, no look at S2 before freeze
classifier.label_order: clusters sorted by centroid f1_ret30 ascending: U1 (weakest/falling), U2, U3 (strongest/rising)
classifier.trials_counted: 1 new classifier configuration is added to the project trial count (k=3). If k=3 is judged unusable the result is reported as such; k is NOT changed afterwards.

evaluation.cells: bundles B1_first5, B2_all33, B3_top5_S1 (S1 inflated, flagged), B4_long_only, B5_first20 (same definitions as ADR 0044) and the 33 candidates, per cluster U1..U3 and per segment: days, mean bp/day, annual SR (only if >=60 days), trades, Newey-West(5) t for bundles. Human rules R1_BULL/SIDE/BEAR and R2_DD recomputed on the same series as the comparison column.
evaluation.persistence: median run length of a label (days) and number of label switches per year, S1 and S2; confusion table of the unsupervised clusters against human R1 labels
evaluation.stability_stats: over the 33 candidates and the 3 clusters (cells with >=60 days in BOTH segments): A_same = number of cells whose mean bp/day has the same sign in S1 and S2; M_pos = number of cells positive in both. Same statistics for human R1 (BULL/SIDE/BEAR).
evaluation.null: 2000 circular shifts of the label sequences (S1 and S2 shifted independently by uniform random offsets, label persistence kept, cluster sizes kept); report the null mean of A_same and M_pos and the fraction of draws >= observed, for the unsupervised labels and for human R1 under the same shifts. The fraction is a descriptive reference, not a pass test.

verdict_rule.USEFUL_AS_DIAGNOSTIC: all of: (a) null fraction for A_same <= 0.05; (b) unsupervised A_same > human R1 A_same; (c) median run length >= 5 days in both segments; (d) every cluster has >=60 days in both segments
verdict_rule.otherwise: NOT_USEFUL (the human rules remain the only regime tool and neither promotes anything)
verdict_rule.even_if_useful: carries no strategy forward by itself: no regime filter is tried here (it would add trials), no candidate is promoted, no window is opened

no_threshold_changes: Statistical criteria, preregs v2/v3, cost profiles, engine untouched. Measured cost, default fees, no relaxed criteria.
